question: Which Indian Cricketer was the special guest at the Melbourne Indian Film Festival in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kapil Dev.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kapil Dev was the special guest at the Melbourne Indian Film Festival in 2022. **

 
 
• He is a former Indian cricketer who is widely regarded as one of th**e greatest all-rounders in the history of cricket.**
 
• Kapil Dev played for the Indian cricket team from **1978 to 1994 **and was the** captain of the team when they won the 1983 Cricket World Cup**, which is considered one of the **greatest moments in Indian cricket history.**
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli** is the Ex. Captain of Indian cricket team and is widely regarded as one of the **best batsmen in the world.**
 
• **MS Dhoni **is a former Indian cricket captain who is known for his excellent leadership skills and his **ability to finish matches.**
 
• **Sunil Gavaskar** is a former Indian cricketer who is regarded as one of the **greatest opening batsmen in the history of cricket.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Kapil Dev**

 
• Kapil Dev is a former cricketer who played for India.
 
• He is also called "The Haryana Hurricane."
 
• He is one of India's best all-around cricket players.
 
• Kapil Dev served as the captain of the Indian cricket team that won the 1983 Cricket World Cup.
 
• He became the first player with 200 one-day international wickets.
 
• He enrolled as a lieutenant colonel in the Indian Territorial Army in 2008. 
 
• **‘Straight from the Heart: An Autobiography is an autobiography of Kapil Dev. Numerous events in Kapil Dev's life are discussed throughout the entire book.**
